protocol.scope: Artifact completeness only; not an independent provenance or convergence certificate.

bootstrap.unit: independent trajectory with all its windows and saved draws
bootstrap.estimand: equal-trajectory mean difference, first method minus second
bootstrap.scope: conditional on fitted models, preprocessing, and fixed saved ensembles; no resampling draws or training
bootstrap.multiple_comparisons: 95% intervals are unadjusted across methods and metrics.

metric_definitions.target: Saved noisy future observations; no latent or clean signals are read or scored.
metric_definitions.crps: Empirical CRPS, matching evaluate_forecast; lower is better.
metric_definitions.mse: Ensemble-mean squared error against noisy future observations.
metric_definitions.interval_width_90: Mean empirical 95th minus 5th percentile, linearly interpolated.
metric_definitions.finite_ensembles: 64 or configured finite draws affect quantiles and empirical CRPS; paired intervals condition on those draws.

cost_definitions.forecaster_training_seconds: Includes validation sampling; validation_sampling_seconds is a subset, not an additional cost.
cost_definitions.method_total_seconds: Preprocessing + forecaster training + test preprocessing + test inference; learned additionally includes mediator fit once.
cost_definitions.scope: Worker elapsed seconds; separate phase wall times may overlap and must not be added to worker totals.

raw.scope: Recorded validation selection; endpoint selection does not prove convergence.

learned.scope: Recorded validation selection; endpoint selection does not prove convergence.

median.scope: Recorded validation selection; endpoint selection does not prove convergence.

across_seed_descriptive.scope: Descriptive paired seed variation; no pooled trajectory or training-seed inference.
